meta.title: FPGA Engineer
meta.tagline: Design custom digital hardware that runs at wire speed.
meta.description: FPGA engineers design digital circuits using Hardware Description Languages (Verilog/VHDL) and implement them on FPGAs. They build high-performance, parallel processing systems for signal processing, networking and acceleration.
